notes.label: Collect the gem behind the supported target shutter and return to the entry cell. Use an offset bar delivered through a folded transport aisle.
notes.goal: Collect the gem behind the supported target shutter and return to the entry cell. Use an offset bar delivered through a folded transport aisle.
notes.change: New spatial realization: one recoverable three-member helper occupies both the outbound upper aisle and the returning lower aisle; the tool must exchange which aisle it uses before final side contact.
notes.reason: The terminal target has inaccessible downward pushing faces, while the short bar provides a supported input end and an offset working end over void. Lowering the helper opens the upper transit lane but occupies the lower return lane. Restoring it must recover that lane after the tool has passed. Contact must be followed by further object work to expose the gem approach.
expectedChecks: Official complete-goal solution and ordinary replay
Helper down and up before contact, including ordered reuse
Required object work after first contact
Actual 3D input playtest from reset to gem-and-return
